relations.relationship: Treats cultural translation and minoritization as processes within discordant cultures rather than relations among seamless cultural wholes.
relations.evidence_note: Complete substantive publisher-posted interview read; opening answers on cultural misfit and translation distinguish Bhabha’s statements from interviewer labels. Parsi historical examples remain his situated testimony, not an essential culture or universal minority model.

relations.relationship: Questions permanent models of belonging through the unequal temporalities and legal conditions of diaspora and refugee life.
relations.evidence_note: Own answers on home, narrative choices and final citizenship/refugee section. His ethical proposal to rethink belonging through refugee impermanence remains an attributed proposal; interview does not show all migrants living an identical condition.
